config.name: r6-ref-first
config.note: Round 6. Reference first on reasoning terrain: the reference check joins stage 1 there; the System-2 verdict is added only when the mix is still under the boundary.

rule_for_a_win: Per benchmark and baseline: paired bootstrap (20,000 draws, resampling prompt groups) of MoJ minus baseline. Holm over the 6 comparisons (3 benchmarks x promptfoo and our ledger). A win when the Holm-adjusted lower bound is above 0 at no more System-2 calls per pair than that baseline; a loss when the upper bound is below 0; else a tie. Overall better only if every cell is a win or a tie and at least one is a win. On writing a win also needs MoJ above longer wins; else the report says the benchmark does not measure judging there.
scoring: JudgeBench: a pair is right only when both games are right (strict); half credit reported beside it. MM-Eval and writing: tie or split counts half.
